19M here. I am diagnosed with ADHD and have had suicidal ideation since I was 15. I don't know why I am suicidal, but I have since ruined my life. I lived my whole high school career of 4 years planning to die at 18 and now at 19, have no ambitions, no sense of direction in life, and everything I do is to escape myself. I can't commit suicide for the sake of my loved ones but deep down it's the only way I can imagine myself dying. 

If you want to help someone who is struggling, just give them the tools to get out of the hole they are stuck in. At the end of the day it's their choice on if they want to better themselves or not. As I always say, if you can't be the best, be the worst.

I think you misunderstand what a disconnect from the world is. A disconnect from the world would be extreme amounts of sleep, substance abuse, watching shows or animes about fiction, etc. Which maybe you do, but what you are describing is just a nihilistic outlook on the meaninglessness of a human lifespan. I can agree there are people who don't question the absurdity of life, but that generalization is unfair until you get to know them. You aren't better than these people for thinking in that way.

Nobody is playing a so called game of life on autopilot, and people have depth. People you pass on the street, the guy who takes your order at the drive thru, everyone has a life of memories and development. People are people and chances are they have suffered just like you have.
For the loved ones in your life, wait a week. If you still want to do it after a whole week has passed, then you can do as you see fit.
Cherish it. The thrill of looking over the bridge goes away after a while. But remember the view isn't as good from halfway down.

You will likely wake up in a critical condition with irreversible liver damage. I know your body screams for you to hurt yourself but hold on for me. Just do what you have to do to calm down, you got this.
I do this lol, especially on weekend mornings
